10001.name: Kent County
10001.note: Held: no source names which fire companies carry BLS patients outside Dover (county paramedics are ALS; Dover BLS is Saint Francis EMS). kentcountyde.gov EMS page 403s (Akamai) and has no Wayback copy.

10003.name: New Castle County
10003.note: Two-tier system: county paramedics (ALS, non-transport) ride with BLS ambulances run by the volunteer fire companies; Wilmington BLS is contracted (Saint Francis EMS). Individual fire companies not listed one by one.
a: New Castle County volunteer fire company BLS ambulances (set; county page counts 21)

10005.name: Sussex County
10005.note: County paramedics do not transport; 21 BLS services (mostly volunteer fire companies) carry patients. Individual services not named by the source.
a: Sussex County fire company / BLS transport services (set; county page counts 21)
